name.description: The name of the field is the key by which it is accessed.

sourceType.description: The type for the {@link UiView} which this UiViewField is part of.

value.description:
The expression by which the value of the field is retrieved. If unspecified, #name must correspond to a field in
the source type.

label.description: The label for this field. If not specified, it will generated as a cleaned-up version of the field name.

group.description: If the fields should be presented in distinct groups, they can be organized into groups by name.

format.description: Value type dependent format string for presentation.

description.description: The short description of this field, typically used as a tool tip.

readOnly.description: Whether this field should disallow editing (regardless of other permissions).

name: UiViewField
